page_title: UDI 1-0 ATA | Udinese v Atalanta 01/11/2025, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+6' That's it for today, Michael Fabbri has blown his whistle and the game is over.
90+4' Ederson (Atalanta) receives a yellow card.
90+3' A good clearance by a defender means the corner comes to nothing for Udinese.
90+2' Charles De Ketelaere (Atalanta) brings an opponent down and Michael Fabbri interrupts the game. Udinese are given an advantage. They have a free kick.
90+1' Charles De Ketelaere (Atalanta) is punished with the yellow card.
90+1' Oier Zarraga (Udinese) decides to speed play up with a short corner kick.
90' 4 additional min. will be played.
89' Nikola Krstovic (Atalanta) fails to find any of his teammates inside the box as his pass is blocked.
86' Kosta Runjaic decides to make a substitution. Adam Buksa will be replaced by Oier Zarraga (Udinese).
84' Substitution. Marco Brescianini (Atalanta) in, Odilon Kossounou out.
84' Charles De Ketelaere (Atalanta) fouls an opponent. At least that's what referee Michael Fabbri signals.
83' Charles De Ketelaere (Atalanta) sends a long crossfield pass searching out one of his teammates, but his effort comes to nothing and they lose possession.
81' Davide Zappacosta (Atalanta) sends in a poor cross from the corner and Maduka Okoye has no trouble gathering it.
81' Raoul Bellanova (Atalanta) delivers a crossfield pass, but the ball is cut out before it reaches its intended target. The referee points to the corner flag and Atalanta will take a corner.
77' Here comes a substitution. Charles De Ketelaere (Atalanta) is brought on as a substitute for Lazar Samardzic.
77' Substitution. Nicola Zalewski makes way for Raoul Bellanova (Atalanta).
76' Marco Carnesecchi leaps to intercept the corner kick from Arthur Atta (Udinese).
75' The referee signals that it is time for a substitution and Matteo Palma (Udinese) will replace Nicolo Bertola.
75' Kosta Runjaic prepares a substitution. Alessandro Zanoli is replaced by Kingsley Ehizibue (Udinese).
74' Vakoun Issouf Bayo (Udinese) takes a mid-range shot, but it lacks accuracy and it goes way over the bar. The ball goes out of play and Atalanta will have a goal kick.
72' Berat Djimsiti (Atalanta) sends a long ball in, but Maduka Okoye comfortably gathers the ball.
69' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Vakoun Issouf Bayo (Udinese) replaces Nicolo Zaniolo.
69' Kosta Runjaic has decided to substitute Jurgen Ekkelenkamp and he is replaced by Jakub Piotrowski (Udinese).
69' Jurgen Ekkelenkamp (Udinese) delivers a long ball, but it lacks enough power to reach his teammates and is intercepted by one of the defenders.
66' Nikola Krstovic (Atalanta) is booked.
64' Hassane Kamara (Udinese) is the one who receives a yellow card.
64' Atalanta seem to be finding their feet as they enjoy some possession. They are waiting for the right moment to create new attacking opportunities.
61' Nikola Krstovic (Atalanta) fails to beat the offside trap and the linesman puts his flag up.
59' Here is a change. Kamaldeen Sulemana is going off and Ivan Juric gives the last tactical orders to Ademola Lookman (Atalanta).
59' Substitution. Gianluca Scamacca did his best and is replaced by Nikola Krstovic (Atalanta).

58' Nicolo Zaniolo (Udinese) gets into a good scoring position. He creates some space for himself and tries his luck from distance. His decent effort towards the right post is, however, superbly saved by Marco Carnesecchi!
55' Lazar Samardzic (Atalanta) takes the corner which is cleared.

55' Gianluca Scamacca (Atalanta) tries his luck with and strikes the ball towards goal from long-range, but it is blocked by one of the defenders. The ball goes out of play. Atalanta are awarded a corner kick.
54' Alessandro Zanoli (Udinese) was trying to get to the ball but clattered into the legs of the opponent as well. Michael Fabbri blows his whistle for an infringement. Atalanta have a free kick.
52' The Atalanta players keep the ball and are exchanging a combination of passes. They are waiting for gaps in the defence to open up.
49' One of the defenders reacts at the last minute to brilliantly block a pass from Lazar Samardzic (Atalanta).
47' Nicolo Zaniolo (Udinese) attempts to send a pass but the effort is blocked.
46' The whistle blows and Michael Fabbri starts the second half.
45+2' That is it for the first half after the referee blows his whistle and the players head to their respective dressing rooms.
45' The fourth official shows 1 min. of added time.
44' Udinese take the corner, but their hopes of scoring a goal end with a nice clearance by the defence.

44' Jesper Karlstrom (Udinese) wasted a huge opportunity! The fans already began to celebrate as he produced a shot from the edge of the box after a brilliant solo effort. The ball went straight towards the roof of the net, but Marco Carnesecchi made an astonishing save! Now Udinese have a corner.
42' A corner kick by Udinese is thwarted by the well prepared Marco Carnesecchi (Atalanta).
40' 1 - 0 Nicolo Zaniolo (Udinese) connects with a pass inside the box and slams home inside the left post. The goalkeeper was helpless.
38' Ederson (Atalanta) reacts well to get to the rebound and takes a shot from the edge of the box, but he fails to get the ball through the players standing between him and the goal.
36' Michael Fabbri blows his whistle after Adam Buksa (Udinese) kicks an opponent's legs instead of the ball.
33' Mario Pasalic (Atalanta) sends a long ball across the pitch, but it misses its target. The ball goes out of play and Udinese will have a goal kick.

33' Michael Fabbri blows his whistle for a foul after Christian Kabasele (Udinese) hacks down one of his opponents. Atalanta win a free kick and will be able to apply some pressure on the opposition goal.

32' Hassane Kamara (Udinese) covers his face with his hands after wasting a promising chance. He takes the rebound on the edge of the box but blazes the ball high over the crossbar. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Atalanta.
31' Isak Hien (Atalanta) makes an overly-aggressive challenge and Michael Fabbri blows his whistle for a foul. Udinese are awarded a free kick. Let's see what they create from this.
29' Udinese enjoy a period of possession as they are exchanging some passes and waiting for an opportunity to strike.
26' Lazar Samardzic (Atalanta) slides a pass forward, but one of the defenders cuts it out.
24' Gooal! No wait, it's been ruled out for offside. Kamaldeen Sulemana (Atalanta) disagrees, but the linesman is sure about his call.
23' The Atalanta players are exchanging some short passes to try and open up the opposition’s defence and hit them swiftly on the break.

20' Hassane Kamara (Udinese) gets into a good scoring position. He creates some space for himself and tries his luck from distance. His decent effort towards the bottom left corner is, however, superbly saved by Marco Carnesecchi!
20' Jesper Karlstrom (Udinese) fails to send a pass into the box as his effort is cut out.
18' Nicolo Zaniolo (Udinese) dribbles into space and finds himself in a shooting position, but his shot from the edge of the box is bravely blocked.
16' Lazar Samardzic (Atalanta) sends the ball into the box from the side of the pitch, but his cross is blocked.
15' Michael Fabbri interrupts the game for a tactical foul by Odilon Kossounou (Atalanta). That's a free kick to Udinese.
13' Mario Pasalic (Atalanta) produces a dangerous lofted cross into the box which is intercepted.
10' Another attempt to send the ball beyond the defence by Berat Djimsiti (Atalanta) is thwarted and cleared to safety.
9' Jurgen Ekkelenkamp (Udinese) knocks his opponent down with an over-the-top tackle.
7' Referee Michael Fabbri sees the trip by Davide Zappacosta (Atalanta) and doesn't hesitate to blow his whistle.
5' Jurgen Ekkelenkamp (Udinese) whips the ball in, but it fails to reach any of his teammates as the opposition's defence averts the threat.
4' Hassane Kamara (Udinese) tries to send a pass but it's blocked.
2' Lazar Samardzic (Atalanta) whips in the corner, but one of the defending players gets a head on it and intercepts.

2' Lazar Samardzic (Atalanta) takes the corner and sends it into the penalty area, but the opposition's defence is ready and makes a good clearance. Atalanta will have a chance to score from a corner kick.
2' Ederson (Atalanta) tries to slide the ball through to a teammate but it's well blocked by a defender. Atalanta earn a corner.
1' The match has just started.
Atalanta will kick-off.
Michael Fabbri will supervise the game today.
